crossRefs.note: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven…
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
Yahweh says, “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I…
When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

translations.web: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
translations.bsb: Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!
translations.kjv: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high
translations.asv: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
